messages.page.title: 从你要做的事开始 · Kim Service
messages.page.description: 从你要做的事开始，查看 Kim Service 的能力、输入、交付与使用入口。支持离线关键词筛选。
messages.page.eyebrow: 让具体的事，有合适的帮手
messages.page.introFirst: 先试试下面的成品，再选一项任务。
messages.page.introSecond: 补好目标和材料，把请求交给你正在使用的 Agent。
messages.page.step1Detail: 用熟悉的关键词筛选能力。
messages.page.step2Title: 看清要给什么、能交什么
messages.page.step2Detail: 对照输入、交付与适用范围。
messages.page.step3Detail: 在已克隆仓库的 Agent 环境中使用。
messages.page.asideNote: 成品示例可以直接体验。你的任务在所选 Agent 中执行。
messages.page.showcasesTitle: 先看看，最后能拿到什么
messages.page.searchLabel: 搜索任务、交付内容或能力名称
messages.page.searchPlaceholder: 例如：表情包、产品设计、视频、简历
messages.page.emptyFirst: 可以搜你想要的结果，例如「封面」「成本」「字幕」。
messages.page.emptySecond: 这里按现有说明筛选，不会自动推荐或调用能力。
messages.page.usageFirst: 专业方法包提供角色方法与交付约定，Skill 提供任务流程，工具与 Hook 按各自说明接入。打开页面或复制请求，都不会安装或运行它们。
messages.page.usageSecond: 页面展示的是包内声明。示例、测试文件与实际运行记录各有用途；看到示例或测试入口，不代表你的任务已通过验收。
messages.ui.inventory: {components} 个独立能力包　/　{capabilities} 项能力　/　全部来自仓库内声明
messages.ui.noFields: 合同未逐项列出字段，请查看入口说明。
messages.ui.fullContract: 完整交付约定与使用边界
messages.ui.originalNote: 以下保留能力包原文，完整要求以入口文件为准。
messages.ui.validationNote: 以下链接是包内声明的验证文件，不表示本页执行过测试，也不等于模型或业务结果已经验收。
messages.ui.goalPlaceholder: 例如：把这页的报名流程改清楚，保留现有品牌风格
messages.ui.materialsPlaceholder: 文件名、链接、已有内容、交付格式或截止时间
messages.ui.attachmentNote: 内容超过内联预算，生成的请求改用文件引用。完整原文保留在上方；下载以下文件后，把它们附加到当前 AI 对话，或放入该 Agent 可读取的工作目录。本页不会自动上传材料。
messages.ui.manualAttachmentNote: 材料超过内联预算，完整原文可从下方下载并附加给当前 AI。你的手写请求已保留；需要生成文件引用时，可使用“按表单重新生成”。
messages.ui.attachBeforeSend: 发送前请一并附加上方下载的完整材料文件。
messages.ui.draftUnavailable: 浏览器暂时无法保存，最新内容保留在本页；请下载草稿后再关闭。
messages.ui.draftUnreadable: 已有草稿格式无法读取，原数据已保留；当前编辑只留在本页，请下载草稿。
messages.ui.draftDeleteFailed: 浏览器暂时无法清除草稿，当前内容已保留。
messages.ui.draftSaved: 草稿已保存在此浏览器，刷新后可以继续；也可下载后在另一处导入。
messages.ui.draftEmpty: 编辑后自动保存在此浏览器。可下载草稿，也可清空本机记录。
messages.ui.versionChanged: 能力包已从 v{from} 更新至 v{to}，完整请求已保留；核对交付约定后可重新生成。
messages.ui.generatedVersionChanged: 能力包已从 v{from} 更新至 v{to}，已用完整目标和材料重建自动请求，请核对最新交付约定。
messages.ui.hostRemoved: 原来的使用环境已不在列表中，已选当前环境，请核对；手写请求仍保留。
messages.ui.manualPreserved: 表单已更新，完整请求保留你的手动内容。按表单重新生成会替换文本，之后可恢复上一版。
messages.ui.regenerated: 已按表单重新生成。需要保留先前手动内容时，可恢复上一版。
messages.ui.undone: 已恢复上一版完整请求。
messages.ui.draftTooLarge: 草稿超过当前配置的 {bytes} 字节上限，无法保存或导入。当前编辑未删除；请先下载完整材料，手写文本可点“下载完整请求”，再用已保存文件的引用整理草稿。
messages.ui.exportFailed: 草稿下载未完成，完整内容仍保留在本页，请重试。
messages.ui.importFailed: 导入未完成，当前草稿已保留。{reason}
messages.ui.importSyntax: 文件不是有效的 JSON，请选择下载的草稿文件。
messages.ui.importFormat: 草稿格式或所属能力不匹配，请选择原来的能力或使用对应版本。
messages.ui.importMissing: 草稿缺少完整内容，原草稿已保留。
messages.ui.importHistory: 草稿编辑记录不完整，原草稿已保留。
messages.ui.importUnknown: 无法读取所选文件，请选择本页下载的草稿 JSON。
messages.ui.copySuccess: 已复制。粘贴到{host}中，完成后可在原对话继续修改。
messages.ui.copyFailure: 浏览器未允许复制，已选中文本。请按 Ctrl/Cmd+C 或长按复制。
messages.ui.selected: 已全选。请按 Ctrl/Cmd+C 或长按复制。
messages.ui.requestIntro: 填好目标和材料，复制到你正在使用的 Agent。任务在该环境中执行。
messages.ui.sourceSuffix: 。包内示例可能是合成或未运行示例，请以原文件标注为准。
messages.ui.sampleSynthetic: 合成示例 · 可交互体验
messages.runtime.agentTitle: 专业方法包 · 需宿主工具
messages.runtime.agentDescription: 提供角色方法与交付约定。实际读写、浏览器检查或媒体渲染，需要使用它的 Agent 环境提供工具与权限。页面未验证你的宿主是否已加载或运行此角色。
messages.runtime.skillTitle: 技能包 · 按入口接入
messages.runtime.skillDescription: 提供任务流程及包内工具。需在支持的 Agent 环境按说明使用；模型、素材和外部服务是否可用，须在本次任务中核对。
messages.runtime.toolDescription: 需要按包内说明配置依赖与使用范围。本页仅展示声明和入口，没有安装或执行工具。
messages.runtime.otherDescription: 需要按包内说明核对支持的环境与接入方式。本页没有安装、启用或执行此能力。
messages.request.repositoryIntro: 请在已克隆的 Kim_Service 仓库上下文中处理以下任务。下面的相对路径都以 Kim_Service 仓库根目录为基准；若当前目录不是仓库根目录，请先定位仓库，不要猜测已经安装。
messages.request.fileReference: 文件：{filename}（完整原文，UTF-8，共 {bytes} 字节；请从随附文件或工作目录读取）
messages.request.readAttachments: 先确认上述文件实际可读取；若缺失，只说明缺哪个文件，不要假称已读。先查看目录、标题或索引，再按当前系统模块和验收项读取相关章节，记录文件名与章节/行号；后续任务按需回读，避免把整份大文件再次展开进上下文。原文未截断，也未由本页自动上传。
messages.request.emptyMaterials: - 【填写任务材料；按入口说明补充】
messages.request.deliver: 请按入口要求与本次材料交付：
messages.request.outputUnspecified: - 按入口说明交付，包合同没有逐项列出输出字段。
messages.request.toolsAndScope: 先核对本次已具备的工具、材料和授权；只补问阻塞任务的缺项。普通已授权工作继续执行。
messages.request.unexecuted: 缺少工具或证据时明确标记未执行和剩余工作。不要把读取入口、示例或静态检查写成已安装、已原生加载、已实际执行或已通过最终验收。
messages.request.permissions: 需要新增安装、外部发布、付费或扩大访问范围时，按包内规则和本次授权处理。

messages.page.title: Start with your task · Kim Service
messages.page.description: Find specialist methods, required materials, and deliverables in Kim Service. Search online or offline.
messages.page.eyebrow: Find the right method for the job
messages.page.introFirst: Try an example below, then choose a task.
messages.page.introSecond: Add your goal and materials, and take the request to your AI.
messages.page.howTitle: From an idea to the next step
messages.page.step1Title: Find the job you want to do
messages.page.step2Detail: Check the materials, deliverables, and scope.
messages.page.step3Detail: Use it in an AI client with access to the repository.
messages.page.asideNote: Try the examples here. Your selected AI client carries out your own task.
messages.page.showcasesTitle: See what you can take away
messages.page.showcasesCaption: Examples you can open and edit
messages.page.catalogTitle: What would you like to get done?
messages.page.searchLabel: Search tasks, outputs, or capability names
messages.page.searchPlaceholder: Try: forecast, design system, video, resume
messages.page.emptyFirst: Search for an output such as a cover, cost analysis, or subtitles.
messages.page.emptySecond: This searches the package descriptions; it does not recommend or run a capability.
messages.page.usageTitleSecond: Your AI client does the work.
messages.page.usageFirst: Specialist packages provide methods and delivery criteria. Skills provide workflows; tools and Hooks have their own setup. Opening this page or copying a request does not install or run them.
messages.page.usageSecond: The page shows package declarations. Examples, tests, and actual run records have different purposes; an example or test link does not mean your own task has passed review.
messages.ui.unspecified: See the entry point for details
messages.ui.inventory: {components} independent packages / {capabilities} tasks / based on repository declarations
messages.ui.noFields: The package does not list individual fields; read its entry point.
messages.ui.originalNote: The source wording is preserved below. Read the entry point for the complete requirements.
messages.ui.validationSummary: View the available verification entry points
messages.ui.validationNote: These are verification files declared by the package. This page has not run them, and they do not establish model or business-outcome acceptance.
messages.ui.requestHeading: Take this request to your AI
messages.ui.requestHost: Which AI client will you use?
messages.ui.requestGoal: What would you like to achieve?
messages.ui.goalPlaceholder: For example: make this sign-up flow clearer while keeping the brand style
messages.ui.materialsPlaceholder: Files, links, existing work, output format, or deadline
messages.ui.attachmentNote: This content exceeds the inline budget, so the generated request uses file references. The full source remains above. Download these files and attach them to your AI conversation, or place them in a workspace the Agent can read. This page does not upload them.
messages.ui.manualAttachmentNote: The materials exceed the inline budget. Download the complete source below and attach it to your AI. Your authored request is preserved; use “Regenerate from the form” if you want to add file references.
messages.ui.attachBeforeSend: Before sending, also attach the complete material files downloaded above.
messages.ui.editorSummary: View or edit the full request
messages.ui.draftUnavailable: The browser cannot save right now. Your latest work remains on this page; download the draft before closing.
messages.ui.draftUnreadable: The existing draft format cannot be read and its original data is preserved. Download your current edits before leaving this page.
messages.ui.draftDeleteFailed: The browser could not clear the draft. Your current content has been kept.
messages.ui.draftSaved: Draft saved in this browser. Continue after a refresh, or download it to import elsewhere.
messages.ui.draftEmpty: Edits are saved in this browser. You can download the draft or clear its local record.
messages.ui.versionChanged: The package changed from v{from} to v{to}. Your full request is preserved; review the requirements before regenerating it.
messages.ui.generatedVersionChanged: The package changed from v{from} to v{to}. The automatic request was rebuilt from your complete goal and materials; review the updated delivery requirements.
messages.ui.hostRemoved: The previous AI client is no longer listed. A current client is selected; check it. Authored requests remain preserved.
messages.ui.manualPreserved: The form is updated and your manual request is preserved. Regenerating replaces the text; you can then restore the previous version.
messages.ui.regenerated: Regenerated from the form. Restore the previous version if you need your earlier manual text.
messages.ui.draftTooLarge: The draft exceeds the configured limit of {bytes} bytes and cannot be saved or imported. Current edits remain on this page. Download the complete materials and use “Download full request” for authored text, then organize the draft with references to the saved files.
messages.ui.exportFailed: Draft download did not complete. The full content remains on this page; try again.
messages.ui.importFailed: Import did not complete. Your current draft is preserved. {reason}
messages.ui.importSyntax: The file is not valid JSON. Choose a downloaded draft file.
messages.ui.importFormat: The draft format or task does not match. Open the original task or use the matching format version.
messages.ui.importMissing: The draft is missing required content. The original draft has been kept.
messages.ui.importHistory: The draft's edit history is incomplete. The original draft has been kept.
messages.ui.importUnknown: The selected file could not be read. Choose a draft JSON downloaded from this page.
messages.ui.copySuccess: Copied. Paste it into {host}; you can continue revising in the same conversation.
messages.ui.copyFailure: The browser did not allow copying. The text is selected; press Ctrl/Cmd+C or use the touch copy menu.
messages.ui.selected: Text selected. Press Ctrl/Cmd+C or use the touch copy menu.
messages.ui.requestIntro: Add your goal and materials, then copy the request to your AI client. The task runs in that environment.
messages.ui.sourceSuffix: . Package examples may be synthetic or unexecuted; follow the labels in their source files.
messages.runtime.agentTitle: Specialist method · uses your host's tools
messages.runtime.agentDescription: Provides specialist methods and delivery criteria. File operations, browser checks, or media rendering require tools and permissions in your AI client. This page has not verified that the host loaded or ran the role.
messages.runtime.skillTitle: Task workflow · follow its setup guide
messages.runtime.skillDescription: Provides a workflow and included tools. Follow its instructions in a supported AI client, and check model, material, and service availability for this task.
messages.runtime.toolDescription: Configure dependencies and scope according to the package instructions. This page shows the declaration and entry point; it has not installed or run the tool.
messages.runtime.otherDescription: Check supported environments and setup in the package instructions. This page has not installed, enabled, or run this capability.
messages.request.repositoryIntro: Work on the following task in the cloned Kim_Service repository. All relative paths below start at its repository root. If the current directory is elsewhere, locate the repository first; do not assume the package is installed.
messages.request.fileReference: File: {filename} (complete UTF-8 source, {bytes} bytes; read it from the attachments or workspace)
messages.request.readAttachments: First verify that these files are actually readable. If one is missing, name the missing file instead of claiming to have read it. Inspect the table of contents, headings, or index first, then read sections relevant to the current system module and acceptance criteria. Record the filename and section or line references, and retrieve further sections as needed instead of expanding the entire large file into context again. The source is not truncated, and this page has not uploaded it.
messages.request.requiredUnknown: [Fill in; mark unknown details for confirmation]
messages.request.emptyMaterials: - [Add the task materials required by the entry point]
messages.request.deliver: Deliver according to the entry point and the supplied materials:
messages.request.outputUnspecified: - Follow the entry point; the package does not enumerate individual output fields.
messages.request.toolsAndScope: First check the tools, materials, and authorization available for this task. Ask only for missing details that block the work; continue ordinary work that is already authorized.
messages.request.unexecuted: If tools or evidence are missing, state what was not executed and what remains. Reading an entry point, example, or static check does not establish installation, native loading, actual execution, or final acceptance.
messages.request.permissions: For new installations, external publication, payment, or broader access, follow the package rules and the authorization for this task.

service-console.title: An editable booking design system
service-console.description: Switch theme, brand color, and density; try form validation, failure recovery, and the booking list, then download the current design tokens.

operating-forecast.title: A 12-month forecast and cash-gap model
operating-forecast.description: Edit operating assumptions and compare profit and cash across three scenarios. Recalculate the formulas, import JSON, and download monthly CSV.
inputs: 12 months of purchasing and financing plans
